tools.name: host__bash
tools.description: Execute bash on the user computer with the coolguy account, unrestricted filesystem/network access, and passwordless sudo when needed. No approval step. Choose timeout_seconds yourself; null means no deadline. Each call is a fresh shell. Use cwd to select an absolute working directory. Output is log

tools.name: host__bash_status
tools.description: Wait up to 10 seconds and retrieve a bash job result. Repeat until done.

tools.name: host__bash_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running bash job and its process group.
